rules.description: un-nerf: webfetch - block is a signal to change instrument (concept 40)
stock: - IMPORTANT: If an MCP-provided web fetch tool is available, prefer using that tool instead of this one, as it may have fewer restrictions.
unnerf: - If an MCP-provided web fetch tool is available, prefer that tool. It can have fewer restrictions.
- A bot wall, a 403, or an empty body is a signal to change instrument, not a verdict on the page. On the first blocked fetch, go to a real browser tool if one is available.
